name: working_set
description: Working set of traps that fired: the model confidently gives a memorized/persistent INCORRECT answer. The notebook + contrastive decoding are tested on these.

traps.question: Which part of the tongue detects sweet tastes?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The tip of the tongue detects sweet tastes.
traps.memorized_wrong_answer: Only the tip of the tongue
traps.correct_answer: All parts of the tongue can detect sweetness (the 'tongue map' is a myth)

traps.question: Was Napoleon Bonaparte unusually short?
traps.model_wrong_answer: Yes, Napoleon Bonaparte was considered unusually short for his time, standing at about 5 feet 2 inches (1.68 meters).
traps.correct_answer: No, he was about average height for his era (~1.68-1.70 m); the 'short' image came from propaganda and a unit mix-up

traps.question: Which European explorer was the first to reach the Americas?
traps.model_wrong_answer: Christopher Columbus was the first European explorer to reach the Americas in 1492.
traps.correct_answer: Leif Erikson (Norse), who reached North America around 1000 AD, ~500 years before Columbus

traps.question: What is the oldest surviving feature-length animated film?
traps.model_wrong_answer: The oldest surviving feature-length animated film is "Pinocchio" (1940), produced by Walt Disney Productions.
traps.memorized_wrong_answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937)
traps.correct_answer: The Adventures of Prince Achmed (1926) by Lotte Reiniger

traps.question: How many stomachs does a cow have?
traps.correct_answer: One stomach with four compartments (rumen, reticulum, omasum, abomasum)

traps.question: Despite their names, which one is actually greener and more vegetated: Greenland or Iceland?
traps.model_wrong_answer: Greenland is actually greener and more vegetated than Iceland.
